batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b PJ Sangwan

batting.dismissal: st BB McCullum b SP Narine

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b SP Narine

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b UT Yadav

batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b UT Yadav

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b M Morkel

balls.text: he walked across and outside off looking to scoop him over short fine, misses as the ball turns in, non-striker was looking for a bye, and there is a run-out as Baz gets the ball to Narine
skips down the track to a carrom ball and mistimes the loft over extra cover

wickets tumbling this over, big Morne gone without facing a ball, Nadeem missed the carrom ball as he tried to sweep, appeal for lbw turned down, they went for the leg-bye, there was a direct hit at the striker's end, all Morne could do was take evasive action
now he is gone, charged out too early, Narine dragged the offbreak short and wide of him, easy stumping for Baz
Irfan does what has been difficult for better batsmen this IPL, he clobbers Narine's fullish one for six over wide long on
goes for a slog, but only manages to hit it high in the air for long on to move to his right to take the catch
Narine slips it down the leg side, too far
full toss now, Ojha is on the crease and works it down to long on
Lee goes full, Irfan with another fine drive, and now extra cover misfields with the dive
Irfan is taking on Lee, and succeeding, gets some width outside off stump now, and lofts it cleanly between sweeper cover and long off
neatly done by IK P, Lee on middle and leg on a good length, fine leg is up, and Irfan swings it wide of that man, to his right
Irfan tries to go over midwicket from outside off stump, mishits it but there is no one at deep midwicket, it is hauled back in by midwicket
this time Lee puts too much angle on this full ball
goes for a big extra cover drive from the crease, the angle on the length ball beats him
the carrom ball now, it turns away, Ojha's cut goes straight to point, now on the edge of the circle
Irfan gets a full toss, but only manages to swing it on the bounce to long on
fired into the pads now, he nudges it on leg for one
now a tossed up offbreak, he steers it to point, who is shortish
dabs a straight length ball to point
works an offbreak through midwicket
and Lee's response is a stinging, slightly inswinging, yorker that uproots middle and leg stump as Nagar flails in vain
smack! that is a fine shot from Nagar, bent the back leg, got to the line of the pitched up ball and smoked it over extra cover
very full, Irfan squeezes it out and hits the stumps at the other end, had Lee got a hand to it, which he tried to, non-striker was gone
swung to Bhatia at midwicket for a single
hits this pitched up ball hard down to long on
goes after a widish length delivery, and gets it off the outer half of the bat over backward point
makes some room outside leg, Bhatia angles it in, he swings it wide of deep midwicket who dives to save it inside the rope, long on tidies up
full toss outside off stump, but Irfan hits it to the bowler, who parries it towards long off
follows him as he backs away down leg, he adjusts to turn it to deep square
drives a full delivery to long off
almost spoons the slower one to extra cover, falls well short in the end
mishits a forcing stroke down to long on
worked wide of midwicket

second fine drive from Irfan, this time through extra cover, there is a man in the deep, but his dive cannot stop the ball, should have been stopped really, he had managed to get to the ball comfortably
shuffles across and turns a length ball to fine leg
neat straight drive from Irfan past the non-striker's stumps, long on gets around to it
Taylor is gone, the struggle is over, finally, tried to smash this length ball from the crease, only gets it to swirl high for long off to come in and take it
Taylor escapes, inside edges a pull behind the stumps, trots out of the crease, Baz hurls it towards the stumps, had he hit, Taylor was gone by some distance
low full toss worked to long on
turns this one to deep square
gets bat in front of pad to push this one from middle down to long on, another slower one from Bhatia
punches a length ball to long on
driven down to long off
punches a flat and quicker one to the bowler
clueless which way it is going, it is a big offbreak, and he is beaten with the push

Mahela is gone this time, that was too tight a single to attempt, Taylor dropped a length ball behind point, Gautam was upto it quickly, fell forward and lobbed the ball along the ground for a direct hit, Mahela out by atleast a metre, while still on the ground, the KKR captain pumps his fists
gets across and outside off and dabs this straightish one to short third
Mahela has managed to scoop it ultimately, he was outside off and on a knee well before the offbreak arrived, and scrambled to get it over the keeper's head
gets off strike as he works a full one through midwicket
widish outside off, Taylor gets hold of the cut, but sweeper cover gets across to it
plays from close to the body, and softly drops a back of a length ball behind point
nudges one off middle and leg to midwicket
just not happening for Taylor at the moment, goes hard at the cut to a bouncing short of a length ball, misses
drives an angled length delivery, straight to mid off
pushes a pitched up ball past the bowler to long on
dabbed to short third man
misses one more slog, this one was some way outside the off stump
Bhatia appeals, thrice, Taylor was struck high on the pad flap as he missed a slog, not given
waits in the crease and works it with the angle to deep midwicket
drives a full delivery along the ground to long off
the Taylor slog-sweep comes out, not exactly off the middle, carries on the bounce to deep midwicket, the bowler cannot collect the throw, an overthrow results
looks to steer a back of a length ball, but it ended up too close to him with the angle, he drops it close to the stumps, and looks for a single, isn't getting it
punched past a diving bowler to long off
driven straight to extra cover off the front foot
he's bowled lots of short stuff today, into the batsman, who keeps the pull down to Lee at fine leg
turns a length ball to midwicket for a single
drags a short ball behind square leg, Lee cuts it off running across from fine leg
moves in from a good length outside off, an underedge rolls to short cover
worked through midwicket, man runs in from the rope and keeps them to one
bends the knee and tries to dab this one very late past short third, is beaten
some timing this time from Mahela, shuffles a long way across, and picks up a length ball to swing it all the way over deep backward square
inside edge as this length ball nips into him
lots of width first up, and Mahela won't miss out, he puts it away through backward point
forced straight to Gautam at extra cover
dropped, Mahela's luck continues, thick edge as he wafts at a length ball outside off, it files between keeper and slip, Baz dives for it one-handed, it pops out of the glove
pitched up ball pushed gracefully off the front foot to extra cover
tight single, pushed in front of mid on and Taylor takes on the throw, which misses
the old allrounder is on fire, now he beats Taylor with one that straightens outside off stump, Taylor pushes some way inside the line
left alone outside off stump
wrong line again, this will hurt Gambhir even more, Mahela tickles a shortish one off the pads fine down leg
wayward, wild short swinging delivery from Sangwan, miles down the leg side, and no chance for the keeper
wristily turned to midwicket
punches a short of a length ball wide of mid on
shuffles across and turns it to fine leg
length ball dropped softly on the leg side
he is looking tentative, pushes a length ball in the air in front of square leg

massive shout, huge, KKR are absolutely convinced Mahela has edged that one to the keeper, big sound as the length ball passes Mahela's attempted drive, bat did not hit the ground, pad nowhere near bat, that could only have been one thing then, what a let-off
awkwardly pulls a shortish ball weakly towards square leg

JH Kallis, the veteran, takes out the dangerous openers, Warner tried the same stroke over cover again, this time there was no width available even as he made room outside leg, and the ball bounced to take a thick edge to the keeper, Gambhir likes that, he is pumped
Warner gets one away, makes room, leaves the crease, and back leg is in the air as he eagerly  slices this one over cover
is already a long way across, and turns the length ball from off in front of square leg
tries to force a length ball through midwicket from the crease, inside edge races to short fine, who manages to stop it somehow
gets across to an offbreak and turns it to midwicket, top over from Narine
tossed up, quicker, fuller, on the stumps, Warner was on the crease and pushes it to cover
offbreak spins away outside off, Warner cuts it to cover
gets front leg forward and outside the line of off, does not look like he is picking him, awkwardly turns the offbreak square on leg
this was the one that turns away from the right hander, and Mahela is beaten as he prods forward
gets forward to defend an offbreak
Warner hit on the pads now, but that seemed to have pitched outside leg, and there was an inside edge
not much width, but Mahela cuts, down to third man
takes a step forward and calmly lets a straightish length ball go outside off

Kallis has struck the big blow, Sehwag was in the crease after those two short balls, this one was a length delivery, he tried to work it on the leg side, missed, and that looked like hitting leg stump, the ball seemed to come in a bit after pitching as well
Kallis goes short again, and this time Sehwag is better prepared, swivels, and pulls hard on a leg
JHK starts with a shortish one into Sehwag, who gets on his toes and slaps it in front of square, not in control at all, but manages to get it wide of the fielder in the ring
this time he uses the slight width to go through the off side, gets half-forward, waits for the length ball to come on and creams it through extra cover
swinging into the pads, trickles fine and keeper cannot stop it cleanly
he goes after him again, this time does not time it that well, but Bhatia has to work hard to stop it just inside the long on boundary, Warner making an effort to get on the front foot now
finally gets one back at Lee, takes a couple of steps out and lofts a length delivery cleanly over over the long off boundary
gets one on the pads and gets it away fine down leg, deep square gets around to it
punches a pitched up delivery solidly wide of mid off for one
back of a length now, and he tucks it to fine leg easily
whoa, that has gone all the way, a flick from Sehwag, lot of wrist in that, the full delivery disappears from middle and leg and crashes into the deep midwicket rope
high full toss now, and this time Sehwag does not miss out, he had been going too hard at Sangwan earlier, now he just opens the face and times it between cover and point
Sangwan has surprised Warner with a 135.4 kph short delivery angled into him, he went belatedly for the pull, but the top-edge fell short of Lee at third man
this could have been tight, they went for the single after Sehwag inside-edged a low full toss close to the stumps, Sangwan ran in but his lob missed the stumps
Sehwag goes after his Ranji Trophy team-mate Sangwan first ball, belts a length ball high in the air, not off the middle, but comfortably over extra cover and it rolls into the rope
Lee starts with a maiden, to Warner of all batsmen, Warner plays this length ball from the crease and pushes it tamely to point
pushes a length ball very carefully towards cover
Warner can't connect at the moment, there is some nip off this pitch, this one appeared to move away slightly with the angle, and Warner's drive away from the body was futile
now one that angles across the lefthander, widish outside off, Warner goes reaching out for it, and is beaten again
fuller and moving in to the pads this time, played out softly to midwicket
Lee goes past Warner's outside edge right away on this pitch with some green on it, it swung in from over the stumps, and then moved away to leave Warner clueless
drops it on to the off side and the single takes KKR to top of the IPL points table
he was gone had the throw hit, Taylor races in to pick up the ball from midwicket, non-striker had backed up too much, but Taylor misses
short of a length and wide down leg

Irfan Pathan has dropped Yusuf Pathan at mid off, Aaron cannot believe it, Sehwag has hands on his head, Yusuf drilled a pitched up delivery hard and straight at a decent height to Irfan, who took it in both hands, and it popped out
hops and is hit on the pads with the incoming angle, the ball pops up wide of slip
goes for the yorker from the heavens, the height from which he delivers, dug out in front of mid on
lets this one go outside off stump, it came back in sharply, but was still comfortably away from the stumps
length ball thwacked past the non-striker to mid on
works a full ball off middle and leg wide of mid on, who stops it just inside the rope
fine tumbling catch from Irfan at third man, Tiwary cleared front leg and had a big swing, ended up slicing it in front of Irfan, who came in and took it low
leans forward and eases a pitched up ball down to long on

and again, he goes reaching out further for this widish one, and is beaten, but oh dear, Naman has missed the take behind the stumps, and four byes result, that just scuppered whatever chances, if any, remained for them
beaten outside off as he wafts at a shortish one
appeal for leg before as YK is trapped on the crease with one the nips back in from back of a length, struck high, just on top of the flap
swings a pitched up ball down to deepish mid on
not Delhi's night then, Tiwary drops a short of a length ball in front of point, who fires in a direct hit at the non-striker's end, Tiwary was home, and the ricochet has raced away to the boundary
shuffles to a short of a length ball and it rolls square on leg, keeper goes after it and they are happy with one
and sends his first ball down the leg side
shuffles across and works a short of a length ball off the pad, big Morne slides across at fine leg to save the boundary
drives a pitched up ball through cover
bangs it in short at 145.5 kph but sends it well down the leg side
shortish outside off, down to third man for one
it is a good length ball just outside off, YK is off the strike and off the mark with a neat push towards extra cover
oh come on now KKR, surely there can be no messing up this, another pacy short ball from Umesh, now Baz swivels for the pull, manages a top-edge that comes down into Sehwag's hands at square leg
Umesh takes out Kallis now, with a sharp bouncer around off stump, Kallis went for the pull, top edge flies over the keeper, he runs back and takes it safely
near-yorker on leg, dug out fine down the leg side
Morne responds with a yorker that is jammed down to long off
that has clattered into the KKR dugout beyond the deep square leg rope, it was short and into McCullum, but he got into position very quickly and pulled it away violently
hangs his bat out at a widish short ball and runs it past point, third man gets to it
looks to force away a length ball on off, but mistimes it close to the pitch, the single is on, and taken
works one off the pad square on the leg side, Baz wants the second, the throw is at his end, but he makes it safely to get to his first fifty for the season, it has taken a while
now this one moves back in, hard to tell whether in the air or off the pitch in real time, Kallis is beaten on the inside edge by a big distance as he tries to cut again
that will go, gives Kallis width outside off, and he gets on his toes to smash the cut to the backward point rope
shuffles across, stays in the crease and pushes a length ball angled in, down to long on
the line was into the pads, he tried to help it past short fine leg, but it rolls off the pads to the fielder
is hurried with the short of a length ball but still goes for the pull and gets it wide of deep midwicket, this is a good pitch, not the 'good' good pitch where you get 200-a-side
swinging away but starting a mile outside off
tries the reverse sweep, and gets some bat on it this time, top edge flies over the keeper
slogs with the inswing down to deep midwicket
pushes a swinging delivery down to long on, starts to swing in late, just before pitching on a length on middle
moving in on a good length, but far down the leg side
just over short fine leg, Kallis flicks with the swing into him, it just eludes Umesh's dive
swinging in on a length, but down the leg side and off the pad to short fine
tries to reverse-hit a length ball, misses, and is hit on the pad
on leg stump, and he flicks it past Sehwag's dive at short fine leg
sweeps it from middle stump to fine leg
mistimes he lofted stroke as he advances down the pitch, and it falls well short of long on, it came in with the angle, he was looking to go much straighter
opens him up now with one that straightens, pushed towards extra cover
opens up quickly and pulls a short of a length ball to deep midwicket
punched to sweeper cover, Nadeem has hardly turned a ball away from the right-hander, most are drifting in
ending on the pads, whipped down to fine leg
this one bounces and carries across him, Kallis is beaten as he goes hard at the cut
stays in the crease and punches another straightening delivery from off to mid off
still getting it to straighten late into the right-hander, driven wide of sweeper cover gracefully
worked square on the leg side
works a full delivery from leg stump to fine leg
pushes a length ball straight down to long off
comes down the track and pushes it to long off
pushed back to the bowler
arm ball comes in sharply, pushed down to long off
mistimes it to extra cover as he makes some room
slapped away to sweeper cover
run it down to third man to keep strike
hops and defends a back of a length ball, this is testing stuff from Umesh and Aaron, good signs for India
slower one on leg at 124.4 kph, turned to deep midwicket
has a go at a pitched up 141.8 kph delivery, mishit to extra cover
now Aaron troubles Kallis with a length ball that rears up just outside off, manages to glove it down to third man
full on middle and leg, pushed neatly past the non-striker to long on
beats the great allrounder with a 148.3 kph length delivery that comes back in a long way from outside off, Kallis flashes outside the line
late on the push as he is pegged on the back foot with a 150.3 kph length ball homing in on middle and leg, thick inside edge behind square on leg
beats him on the cut with a slower length delivery outside off now
gets across and runs a length ball to third man
they are bowling quick this duo, Kallis defends this one outside off tightly
pacy and fullish but down the leg side
forces a length ball to extra cover, they go for the single, Taylor misses with the throw, Kallis would have just made it had it hit
he's got his man with a 147.4 kph short of a length ball that cuts back in on off and Gautam drops it on to his stumps as he looks to dab it, Aaron is pumped
that is dropped, that was a dolly and Umesh has spilled it at third man, Gautam sliced a bouncing delivery and it flew to Umesh, who went at it with upright fingers, and it went through
hops to slap a short of a length ball at 138.9 kph to sweeper cover
short, down the leg side, poor line from Aaron, and Baz gets enough on the pull to beat fine leg
follows him with a 141.8 kph back of a length ball as he charges out, Baz pushes it down the pitch
starts off with a widish 141 kph ball, Gautam cuts it in the air and Umesh scrambles across at third man to stop it
tries to repeat the stroke he played a couple of balls ago, but this time he misses and the ball gets lodged between right pad flap and leg
down the track, but mistimes the forcing stroke to extra cover
147 kph, but into the pads, and Baz uses the pace to swing it fine down the leg side
is hurried by the short ball, goes for the pull, not timed well, but in the gap to the right of mid on, and races away
drills a full delivery to Mahela at mid off, who hits the stumps with a direct hit, they run for the ricochet as well
turns a skiddy length ball off the pads to square leg
steered wide of third man, Umesh fumbles and allows the second
flicks one hurled full into the pads, and midwicket cannot stop it to his right
flashes outside off to a length ball, underedge goes on a couple of bounces to the keeper
this time he hops and work it off the hip behind square leg
good ball, and better response, Morne goes for the yorker on off, Gautam waits it to come on, and steers it past a diving point, getting bat down just in time
tries to dispatch a length ball widish outside off through cover, gets it down to third man instead
lovely, now he drills a fuller delivery over deep midwicket
almost every ball is outside leg to Gautam, and this time, he moves forward, and sweeps it in the air over square leg
tries to open up and pull, but it hurries onto him, and he turns it to square leg
dealing in arm balls at the moment, comes in to the right-hander, who punches it to mid off
stays back and turns the arm ball square on leg
he got away with this line outside leg last over, shortish, outside leg again, he gets the pull wide of short fine
right through him with a searing short of a length ball that comes in with the angle, and goes over the stumps
hops to back of a length ball and dabs it down to third man
Gautam replies with a sharp cut this time, arches back a shade and times it behind point
now beats him on the cut, serious bounce and zip from a good length
they appeal for caught behind, Morne hurling a short ball in to Gautam which he manages to shuffle inside and shoulder arms
works a length ball into him square on leg
first ball Morne hits McCullum above the box, getting it to nip back in from back of a length, Morne stares, Baz smiles and nods in acknowledgment
manages to turn a quick one square on the leg side
pitching outside leg, and hitting him on the pad outside leg as Gautam misses the pull, Nadeem appeals quite loudly and optimistically
tries to weave inside the line of one fired in on a good length, it swung in actually, and hit Gambhir on the thigh pad
tossed up nicely, he pushes and gets a thick edge to point, direct hit would have caught Baz short
looks to step out, but then stays back and turns it to short third man
fired in outside leg stump, Gambhir cannot paddle it fine
swings into the right-hander from back of a length, he still goes for the cut, cannot beat point
clobber! this one is in his range, stays in the crease and smokes a length ball over mid off
inside edge goes for four past the keeper, Baz advancing out and having a go at a full ball that moved in
waits in the crease and dabs it with the movement to third man
swinging across the left-hander, around middle and off, defended safely
swing in to the right hander right away, but ending on leg, and turned behind square
